name: Ayatsuri Bloomer
source:
Main character prays to the God to have all girls wear bloomers at school again, and his wish comes true! New school director affirms bloomers as gym suit. But when he sees school nurse in bloomers palpating his lower abdomen, he learns that the curse of bloomers has covered the whole school.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角祈求上帝让所有女孩都能重新穿上灯笼裤上学，他的愿望实现了！新任校长确认灯笼裤是运动服。但当他看到穿着灯笼裤的学校护士抚摸他的小腹时，他得知灯笼裤的诅咒已经覆盖了整个学校。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-july-2005-swan-song.html]vndbreview[/url]]
